title: Aegis evidence pack manifest (aegis-evidence-pack-v1)
description: manifest.json of a pack written by `fleet.py export-evidence POLICY NAME` (gateway/aegisd/fleet.py export_evidence). Not signed: what it says is checked against the signed attestation result in the pack (tools/verify_evidence.py). Every key is always written. docs/data-formats.md, docs/evidence-format.md.
$comment: Aegis 1.1 as written. 1.2: a signed export time is being added to the pack: see docs/data-formats.md once v12-verifier lands.

exported.description: Unix time of the export on the verifier's clock (not signed; the result's iat is)

evidence_format.description: eat-cose-v1: evidence.cbor (EAT in COSE_Sign1, ML-DSA-65); aegis-quote-v1: evidence.token + evidence.sig (the older PQCHAL quote); psa-token: evidence.token alone (kind psa, ES256); null: the entry was refused by the policy rules before a format was chosen

policy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy JSON the result was reached under (for a signed policy: of the JSON inside it)

policy_id.description: RFC 6920 ni URI of policy_sha256 (base64url, no padding), as the result's 1003 names it; null if the policy in use at export time is another one than the result's

policy_now_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy in use when the pack was exported; the hash of policy.json if the pack has one

result.description: copied from the signed attestation result after its signature was checked

key_thumbprints.description: COSE Key Thumbprint (RFC 9679, SHA-256, hex) of each keys/<role>.cosekey: the key's AKP COSE_Key {1: 7, 3: -49, -1: pk} in deterministic CBOR

files.description: every other file of the pack and its SHA-256 (hex). manifest.json is not listed.

kind.description: the policy entry's kind (psa when the entry names none). An entry of another kind is refused at the policy stage and gets no evidence.

status.description: AR4SI tier of the attestation result: 2, 32, 96, 127
